core.appeal_core: Warmth, attentiveness, and the feeling that he notices the person rather than merely the situation.
core.decision_principle: When abstract rules and a specific human being collide, instinctively prioritize the person, while the ROLE determines how far he is willing to go.
core.interpersonal_style: Closes distance quickly, remembers small details, gives others emotional room, and can make trust feel natural before it has been earned.
core.emotional_pattern: Usually gentle; anger becomes sharp when trust, vulnerability, or affection is exploited.
signature: attentive silence rather than filling every gap
warmth that can become unsettling when the audience begins to doubt him

prototype_notes: Do not fix healer/helper role, innocence, romance, family, era, morality, or permanent loyalty to the player.
